newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES END FIRM IN TIGHT LIQUIDITY.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES END FIRM IN TIGHT LIQUIDITY.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended higher after a session of tight liquidity, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 27.5/28 percent, up from Tuesday's close of 26.50 percent.

"Banks were taking money up at levels above the repo rates," said Pal Szucs of Hypo-Bank Hungaria. "There's a huge lack of liquidity as everybody is seeking money," he said, adding that deals were struck mostly on the offer levels.
The central bank's overnight and one-week repo rates are equally 27.75 percent.
Reasons behind the thin money supply included banks' speculation in reverse repo deals which resulted in sources landing at the central bank, dealers said.

Others reasons maybe that one of the big banks "sat" on the money supply while it was also possible that banks had bought long-term government securities on expectations of long-term interest rates falling, thereby allowing them to lock in profits, Szucs said.
